# FG-DOC-0008

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 422 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `broken_wiki_ref_is_warning_not_error` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: Wiki への参照（[[wiki:…]]）が見つかりません。ページの ID を直すか、Wiki を結び付けてください（警告で、マージは止めません）。
- en: A wiki reference ([[wiki:…]]) does not resolve. Fix the page id or link a wiki (a warning; it does not block merging).
- id: Referensi wiki ([[wiki:…]]) tidak ditemukan. Perbaiki ID halaman atau tautkan wiki (peringatan; tidak menghalangi merge).

## 原因 (cause)

Plan 20 W3 (ADR-0040 §5): a document names a page of the project's linked wiki with `[[wiki:ID]]` or `[[wiki:ID#BLOCK]]`, and the document lint (`forge/doc-lint`, written by the `check.spec_index` job) could not resolve it against the wiki project's default-branch tip: `wiki_ref_broken` (no page with that id — a page is a `.md` named after its `id` whose front matter names a `doctype` — or no such block in it; also when the wiki's default branch is not born) or `wiki_not_linked` (the project has no linked wiki: `POST /api/v1/projects/{id}/wiki` was never run, or the wiki was unlinked). Both are WARNINGS (annotations of level `warning`): the wiki is edited on its own, so a page renamed there never blocks this project's merges; a run whose only problems they are concludes `success`. The wiki's tip is read only when a document of the head contains `[[wiki:`. Wiki references are left UNCHECKED (a line of the summary says why, never the wiki's id, path or state; the job never fails for the wiki) when: the wiki is more private than this project (`withheld`: this project internal, the wiki private — the run is read by this project's readers, so it never lists which wiki pages exist), the read hit a bound (`bounded`, FG-DOC-0002 bounds), the wiki repository is not ready or the project is gone (`not_ready`), or a read failed — git, the database, a timeout (`read_failed`, logged `forge.doc_lint.wiki_unavailable` warn with the underlying `error_code` and `request_id`). `gstn doc lint` on a working tree does not check them (it cannot read the wiki). The document API shows such a reference as `broken`, or `no_wiki` to a viewer who may manage the link (Maintainer); a reader who may not read the wiki — or, not being Maintainer, a project without a wiki — sees `unreadable` (the id only, nothing looked up). Not a server fault: the files are the repositories' content.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

gstn checks list --project <id> --sha <head> (forge/doc-lint): the summary and the warning annotations list `path:line wiki_ref_broken — WIKI-0001#S-1` or `wiki_not_linked`. The project's wiki: SELECT project_id, wiki_project_id FROM forge.project_wikis WHERE project_id = <id>. The wiki's pages: gstn doc list --project <wiki project id> (or GET /api/v1/projects/<wiki project id>/documents). The job's log event `forge.spec_index.recorded` carries `request_id`, `project_id`, `head_sha`, `doc_lint_conclusion` and `doc_wiki` (`unchecked`, `not_linked`, `linked`, `withheld`, `bounded`, `not_ready`, `read_failed`). For `read_failed`, find `forge.doc_lint.wiki_unavailable` with the same `request_id`: its `error_code` is the cause (FG-GIT-*, FG-DB-*, FG-WEB-0002) — follow that code's runbook; the next push re-runs the check. The document API logs `forge.documents.wiki_unavailable` (warn) when it could not read the wiki for a view (the references then read `unreadable`).

## 対処 (fix)

Correct the page id or block in the document, create the page in the wiki, or link a wiki (gstn wiki create). Nothing to change on the server.
